_comment: Single-container Docker platform (Dockerrun v1). This was previously v2
(multi-container/ECS), where Elastic Beanstalk environment properties are
NOT injected into containers - values had to be hardcoded in the
containerDefinitions environment array, which is why a plaintext database
password was committed here. On v1, EB environment properties are injected
as real OS environment variables and Spring reads them natively, so no
secret needs to live in this file. The v2 multi-container platform is also
retired. Configure all environment properties in the EB console - see
